create_LossEvalHook: create a LossEvalHook to evaluate validation loss periodically during detectron2 training
run_LossEvalHook_after_step: run the LossEvalHook after_step method to trigger loss evaluation at specified intervals
run_LossEvalHook__do_loss_eval: run the LossEvalHook _do_loss_eval method to compute and log averaged validation losses
run_LossEvalHook__get_loss: run the LossEvalHook _get_loss method to extract loss metrics from model output in loss_only, loss_proposal, or meanteacher mode
create_inference_context: create an inference_context context manager to temporarily set a torch model to eval mode and restore it afterwards
